He is a 2.06 m (6 ft 9 in) tall [[small forward]] that can also play as a [[point forward]]. His older brother, [[Thanasis Antetokounmpo]], is also a professional basketball player.[http://nbadraft.net/players/athanasios-adetokoubo NBADraft.net Athanasios Adetokoubo.] His nickname is "The Greek Freak".[http://soaringdownsouth.com/2013/04/12/brads-beat-610-pg-known-as-the-greek-freak-turning-heads-in-nba-draft/ Soaringdownsouth.com Brad’s Beat: 6’10 PG Known As The “Greek Freak” Turning Heads in NBA Draft.] ==Professional career== Antetokounmpo started playing basketball at the age of 12 with the youth teams of Filathlitikos in Greece. He began his professional career in [[Greek basketball league system|Greece's 2nd-tier basketball league]], the [[HEBA A2|Greek A2 League]], with the senior men's club of [[Filathlitikos BC|Filathlitikos]] in the 2012-13 season. When he turned 18, in December 2012, he signed a four-year contract with the [[Liga ACB|Spanish League]] club [[Basket Zaragoza 2002]].[http://basketballplus.nl/18-jarige-giannis-adetokunbo-naar-cai-zaragoza/ BasketballPlus.nl 18 jarige Giannis Adetokunbo naar CAI Zaragoza {{nl icon}}.] The contract with Zaragoza is worth €250,000 [[Euro|euros]] [[net income]] per season, and runs through the 2013-14 to 2016–17 seasons, with the last season being an option year.[http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=90030 ACB.com Basket CAI Zaragoza se hace con los derechos de Giannis Adetocunbo {{es icon}}.] The contract also includes an affordable buyout clause that can be exercised by any team that plays in the [[NBA]] or the [[Euroleague]].[http://www.nytimes.com/2013/06/26/sports/basketball/in-an-athens-suburb-nba-scouts-unearth-a-rare-find.html?pagewanted=all NYTimes.com A Hunger for a Better Life May Lead to the N.B.A.] He stayed with Filathlitikos, for the remainder of the 2012-13 season. During the Greek A2 League 2012-13 season, Antetokounmpo shot 46.4% from the field overall (62.1% on 2 PT field goals), 31.3% on 3 PT field goals, and 72.0% on free throws, while averaging 22.5 minutes per game.[http://www.fiba.com/pages/eng/fc/gamecent/p/leagueid/GRE2/ot//pid/6059561/season/2013/tid/6001266/playerview.html FIBA.com GIANN ANTETOKOUBO | Season 2012/2013 - Accumulated Stats Tab.] He averaged 9.5 points, 5.0 rebounds, 1.4 assists, 0.7 steals, and 1.0 blocks per game, in 26 games played. He also had a [[Performance Index Rating|PIR]] of 8.3.[http://basketball.eurobasket.com/team/Filathlitikos_AO/7423?Page=3 Filathlitikos 2012-2013 Statistics.] He was also selected by the coaches as a special participant in the 2013 [[HEBA Greek All Star Game|Greek League All-Star Game]]. In addition to playing in the 2nd-tier Greek A2 League during the 2012-13 season, he also played in [[Greek basketball league system|Greece's 5th-tier ESKAN league category]] for youth competitions. Because of this situation, during the 2012-13 season, he played in two separate league competitions for the same [[sports club|club]] in Greece, playing both for the senior men's team of Filathlitikos and for one of the team's junior squads. On April 28th, 2013, it was announced that Antetokounmpo was officially entering his name into the [[2013 NBA Draft]], as an early entrant.[http://www.eurohoops.net/2013/04/dribbling/23820 Eurohoops.net Adetokunbo enters the draft.] Giannis is projected to be a mid-late first round player in this draft. ==Greek national team== Antetokounmpo has been a member of the Greek junior national teams. ==Personal== Giannis Antetokounmpo was born in [[Athens]], [[Greece]] to [[Nigeria|Nigerian]] parents.[http://www.fiba.com/pages/eng/fc/news/colu/p/newsid/55082/arti.html FIBA.com Adetokoubo's whirlwind saga just starting.] Although he is of Nigerian descent, he does not have Nigerian nationality.[http://www.sport24.gr/Basket/ElladaBasket/ginontai_ellhnes_oi_antetokoumpo.2212687.html Γίνονται Έλληνες οι Αντετοκούμπο {{el icon}}.] He officially gained full Greek citizenship on May 9, 2013, with the official legal spelling of his name being Giannis Antetokounmpo.[https://twitter.com/DimitropulosFCM/status/332489901717196801 Giannis Antetokounmpo received today his Greek citizenship. As of today, this shall be the official name/surname as it appears in ID/Passport.] Giannis has two older brothers, named Francis and [[Thanasis Antetokounmpo|Thanasis]], as well as two younger brothers, named Kostas and Alexis.[http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Giannis-Adetokunbo-7223/ Draftexpress.com NBA Draft Prospect of the Week: Giannis Adetokunbo.] Thanasis was a teammate of his with Filathlitikos, and he also played with him in the 2013 [[HEBA Greek All Star Game|Greek League All-Star Game]], while Francis has played [[Association football|football]] professionally in Nigeria. All of the Antetokounmpo brothers have played basketball in the Filathlitikos system. ==Awards and accomplishments== *[[HEBA Greek All Star Game|Greek League All-Star Game]]: (2013) ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://twitter.com/GAdetokunbo Twitter Account] *[http://www.fibaeurope.com/cid_KNce8jInH7Qj1EsyH5rjn2.playerID_99285.compID_UIfgjyQcGqk-fPlnl66Tj0.season_2013.roundID_9350.teamID_291.html FIBA Profile] *[http://basketball.eurobasket.com/player/Giannis_Adetokoubo/Filathlitikos_AO/230437 Eurobasket.com Profile] *[http://www.fcmbasketball.com/portal/index.php?option=com_content&id=825%3Aadetokoubo-giannis&Itemid=9 FCM Profile] *[http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Giannis-Adetokunbo-7223/ Draftexpress.com Profile] *[http://nbadraft.net/players/giannis-adetokoubo NBADraft.net Profile] *[http://www.eurohopes.com/player/1750/giannis-adetokoubo/ Eurohopes.com Profile] {{Persondata | NAME = Antetokounmpo, Giannis | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = Adetokoubo, Giannis; Adetokunbo, Ioannis; Adetocunbo, Giannis; Antetokoumpo, Ioannis; Adetokunbo, Giannis; Adetokoumbo, Ioannis; Antetokoubo, Giannis; Adetokubo, Giannis; Antetokoumpo, Giannis | SHORT DESCRIPTION = Greek professional basketball player | DATE OF BIRTH = December 16, 1994 | PLACE OF BIRTH = [[Greece]] | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Antetokounmpo, Giannis}} [[Category:1994 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Filathlitikos B.C. players]] [[Category:Greek basketball players]] [[Category:Greek people of Nigerian descent]] [[Category:Point guards]] [[Category:Power forwards (basketball)]] [[Category:Shooting guards]] [[Category:Small forwards]]
